title: Move Zeroes
constraints: The same array must be updated while preserving non-zero order.

examples.explanation: The non-zero values keep their original order.

solutionApproaches.title: Build a New Array
solutionApproaches.explanation: Collect non-zero values and append zeroes, but this violates the in-place requirement.

solutionApproaches.title: Two-Pointer Write Cursor
solutionApproaches.explanation: Use a write pointer that only advances on non-zero elements, filling trailing positions with zero.
